title: Ye Qing's Visit
next_chapter_hook: The moment Chen Ji gripped the jade slip, a blurry image emerged on the Tianji Record Fragment—Chen Nian imprisoned in pitch-black void, countless golden chains coiling behind her.

text.content: The backlash of the Tianji Record surged like a tide, his skull feeling as if pierced by ten thousand needles. Chen Ji curled up in the most remote corner of the Servants' Quarters, cold sweat soaking through his thin blue inner garment, fingertips digging desperately into the cold blue bricks beneath him, yet not a single groan escaped his lips. This pain, he had long grown accustomed to. Three years—every time he used the Tianji Record to peer into heavenly secrets, he had to bear this arrow-through-the-heart cost. But today was different. During the battle, he had 'accidentally' leaked clues about his sister to Ye Qing. He needed the Demonic Holy Sect's intelligence network.

The moonlight outside the window was frost-like, cutting the shadows of the decrepit window lattice into mottled fragments. Chen Ji laboriously pulled out a verdant pill from his chest—that was a pain-relieving elixir he'd bought with three years of accumulated servant wages, something he couldn't bear to use easily. Usually, this level of pain he could endure by gritting his teeth. But today was different. The clue about his sister Chen Nian had just been 'inadvertently' revealed to Ye Qing on the battlefield. He needed to borrow the Demonic Holy Sect's intelligence network.

A black shadow silently glided over the window lattice. Before Chen Ji could even react with any defensive posture, the Demonic Path Saint Maiden Ye Qing was already standing three feet away. Tonight she wasn't wearing her signature black纱 battle robe, but plain white casual clothes, her raven hair simply pinned up with a silver hairpin, looking less sharp as a Saint Maiden and more like an ordinary woman's gentleness. Yet those eyes remained cold and deep as an abyss, as if capable of seeing through all pretense in this world.

Chen Ji raised his pale face, even managing a faint smile at the corner of his lips: "Does the Saint Maiden's late-night visit mean she's come to check on this waste's injuries?" Though his tone was flippant, his hand had already quietly pressed against the storage bag at his waist—inside were talismans for a trapping formation, capable of困住 a Golden Core stage cultivator in an instant. Prudence was an instinct刻进 his bones.

dialogue.content: "You really do look like a废物 right now." No mockery could be heard in Ye Qing's voice, only an indescribable complex emotion. She walked closer slowly, her gaze sweeping over the blood seeping from Chen Ji's temple, her brow slightly furrowed. "The backlash from the Tianji Record... more severe than I imagined. What did you see that required three consecutive glimpses?"

text.content: Chen Ji gave no answer, simply placing the pain-relieving pill into his mouth, closing his eyes to slowly dissolve the medicine's power. After a moment, he opened his eyes, his expression already restored to its usual calm: "The Saint Maiden made this special trip, surely not just to care about my life or death?" He knew Ye Qing too well—this woman's heart was like a viper's, she would never offer assistance without reason.

dialogue.content: "News about your sister." Ye Qing drew from her sleeve a warm jade-like tablet, still carrying a faint lingering fragrance. "She asked me to pass this to you."

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. His hand trembled slightly as he took the tablet, fingertips stroking over the familiar grain—this was the letter style Chen Nian had used since childhood, the edge still bearing a small nick from when she'd accidentally bumped it. Three years.整整 three years, he had traversed the territories of three major sects, laid out schemes among the Demonic Path's hidden agents, searched through demonic beast classics, all just to find a trace of his sister. Now, her personal letter was right in his hand, yet it filled him with unprecedented dread.

The handwriting on the letter was elegant—that was indeed Chen Nian's penmanship. But as Chen Ji read through it word by word, his brow furrowed more and more tightly. The letter's content seemed ordinary enough—just reassuring news, asking about her brother's well-being, mentioning her life at the Holy Sect... However, hidden in certain transitions between sentences lay secret codes from his childhood agreement with Chen Nian. "Brother, do you know if the old locust tree in our hometown is still there?"—that was where they'd played hide-and-seek as children. "The embroidery Mother taught me, I still haven't mastered."—embroidery stitching techniques pointed to the character "needle."

dialogue.content: "She's investigating matters related to you." Ye Qing's voice interrupted his thoughts. "Recently, the Holy Sect received an injection of resources from outside—spirit stones, elixirs, even lost secret manuals. The quantity was enough to sustain a medium-sized sect. The source was unclear, but what could be determined was that the usage rights for these resources fell to your sister."

text.content: The knuckles of Chen Ji's fingers gripping the tablet turned white. A chill climbed from the soles of his feet to his heart. Someone was secretly funding the Holy Sect, and their target was directly Chen Nian. This was no coincidence. For them to bypass the Holy Sect's strict surveillance and directly deliver resources into the hands of a "Lock Key," the depth of their infiltration within the Holy Sect far exceeded his imagination. He had been laying plans for three years, priding himself on having considered every possibility, yet had never detected the existence of this mysterious force.

dialogue.content: "There's one more thing." Ye Qing's voice suddenly dropped lower. "Among those resources... some portion flowed into my hands." She looked at Chen Ji's suddenly sharpening gaze,苦涩 smiled. "Did you think where the cultivation resources for the Demonic Path Mist came from? I've also been kept in the dark, only discovering the anomaly last month. Someone is secretly supporting me, and—they seem to want us to cooperate."

text.content: Chen Ji remained silent for a long while, fingertips gently tapping the edge of the tablet, making soft tapping sounds. This mysterious force, sending resources to Chen Nian on one side, supporting Ye Qing on the other—what was their purpose? If they wanted to use Chen Nian, this "Heavenly Fate Lock Key," wouldn't directly controlling the Holy Sect be more convenient? Why take such a circuitous route, especially creating connections between them as brother and sister? Unless... their purpose wasn't the Holy Sect at all, but Chen Ji himself.

He closed his eyes, the Tianji Record Fragment smoldering faintly in the depths of his consciousness. He wanted to peer into it, but the剧烈的 headache forced him to abandon this thought. Never mind. What mattered most now was confirming Chen Nian's safety. That girl had been stubborn since childhood,宁愿 breaking rather than bending. If she knew she was being used as a chess piece, she would definitely do something unpredictable. He had to see her as soon as possible.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji gripped the tablet tightly, his heart churning with complex emotions. News of his sister gave him both comfort and worry, and the existence of that mysterious force was like a thorn lodged in his throat. How should he choose?

choices.description: His sister was his only relative, three years of separation had already caused him endless torment. Since there was a clue, he should act immediately.
choices.visible_cost: Expose His Whereabouts, Alert the Enemy
choices.visible_reward: Confirm Chen Nian's Safety as Soon as Possible
choices.risk_hint: The Mysterious Force Might Have Set a Trap

dialogue.content: "I want to see her." Chen Ji abruptly raised his head, his eyes flashing with a rare sharp light. "Even if it's a dragon's pool or tiger's den, I will bring her back."

choices.description: The mysterious force's purpose was still unclear—rushing into action might just fall right into their trap. Better to first lay low and investigate, get a clear picture of the other party's details.
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian Might Be in Greater Danger

dialogue.content: "Wait." Chen Ji took a deep breath, tucking the tablet securely against his body. "The more critical the moment, the less we can panic. Since that force chose to let us know, it means they need us to move. If I act rashly, I'd only fulfill their wishes."

"You've changed." Ye Qing suddenly spoke, her voice carrying a barely detectable softness. "The you from three years ago would never have said such words. Back then, your heart and eyes held only revenge. You were like a sword drawn from its sheath—sharp but easily broken."

text.content: Chen Ji was slightly stunned, then forced a self-deprecating smile: "That version of me was indeed stupid. Thinking that as long as I was strong enough, ruthless enough, I could protect everyone. And the result?" He lowered his eyes, his eyelashes casting a shadow on his eyelids. "The night Nian'er was taken away, I made a vow—never will I let such a thing happen again. For this vow, I'm willing to lie low for ten years, twenty years, even if it means being a废物 forever."

dialogue.content: "But you've never been a废物." Ye Qing's voice suddenly rose several notches, stepping closer, her gaze burning as she stared at him. "Chen Ji, you think I can't see through it? In these three years at Tianqing Sect, how many secret manuals went missing from the Servants' Quarters, how many spiritual beasts died in the Beast Garden, why do the medicinal herbs in the Alchemy Room always mysteriously run short? Your schemes are deeper than those old foxes in the Holy Sect!"

text.content: Chen Ji said nothing, simply gazing at her quietly. The two stared at each other for a long while. Finally, Ye Qing shifted her gaze, softly saying: "I won't probe into your secrets. Just as you won't probe into my past. We're allies, our interests align, mutual non-interference. That was our agreement." She paused, then drew another token from her chest. "This is a passage token for inside the Holy Sect. I can only help you this much—I'll keep watch on Chen Nian's movements within the Holy Sect. The moment there's news, I'll inform you first."

choice.prompt: The passage token Ye Qing offered glowed with a cold gleam under the moonlight. This was the rare trust of the Demonic Path Saint Maiden, and also a letter of introduction she risked exposure to deliver. How should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Ye Qing's trust came not easily—she risked herself to bring news and the passage token. This was true ally friendship.
choices.visible_reward: The alliance with Ye Qing becomes more solid
choices.risk_hint: This favor may need to be repaid in the future

dialogue.content: Chen Ji extended his hand and solemnly accepted the token. It felt cold in his palm, yet carried the weight of a thousand jun. He looked at Ye Qing seriously: "Ye Qing, this favor, I'll remember it."

choices.text: Promise to Be Each Other's Backstop
choices.description: Between allies, it should be like this. Not just her helping him—if she ever needs it, he would also extend a helping hand.
choices.visible_reward: Establish a Deeper Bond with Ye Qing
choices.risk_hint: May Be Pulled into Her Troubles in the Future

dialogue.content: "You help me, and I won't let you help for nothing." Chen Ji tucked the token into his chest, then lifted his eyes to stare directly at Ye Qing. "One day, if the Demonic Holy Sect betrays you—I, Chen Ji, will tear it apart for you."

Ye Qing was stunned for a moment, then her face broke into a smile. That smile stripped away all the Saint Maiden's coldness and scheming, resembling a red plum blooming in the depths of winter—stunningly beautiful yet carrying a hint of fragility. "Good. I'll be waiting for that day."

text.content: A night wind rose outside the window, stirring a few strands of Ye Qing's blue-black hair. She said nothing more, turning to leave. But just as her figure was about to disappear into the darkness, she suddenly halted, and without turning her head, said: "Chen Ji, have you calculated the cost of the Tianji Record? When your Heavenly Fate Value runs out, have you thought about what will happen?" The words fell, and her silhouette had already vanished like a specter into the night.

Chen Ji stood alone at the window, his hand stroking Chen Nian's letter and that passage token. Ye Qing's words were like a thorn, piercing the softest place in his heart. Heavenly Fate Value... Of course he'd calculated. Every use of the Tianji Record consumed 5 points of Heavenly Fate Value. After three years, he had already used nearly two hundred points. And his original Heavenly Fate Value was said to be a mere three hundred. Now, he was standing at the edge of destiny's cliff. But to find his sister, to survive in this chaotic world, he had no choice.

Moonlight fell, stretching his shadow long and thin. Chen Ji slowly drew the Tianji Record Fragment from his chest, golden characters faintly glowing in the darkness. He wanted to peer into Chen Nian's current safety, but the moment he touched that familiar power, a剧烈的 sting burst from his brow center, forcing him to stop. Never mind. The codes in the letter had already told him the answer—"needle" meant Chen Nian was in danger but temporarily safe; the old locust tree was her hint for a meeting point.

Chen Ji took a deep breath and tucked the fragment back into his chest. His sister was waiting for him. That mysterious force was waiting for him too. And he—will never let them down. Lying dormant for three years, he had long grown accustomed to weaving chess games in the shadows. This time would be no exception. "Nian'er, brother will definitely find you." He murmured softly, his voice barely audible, yet an unprecedentedly firm fire burned in his eyes.

What he didn't notice was that the moment he closed his eyes, on the back of the Tianji Record Fragment, a vague rune quietly appeared, then vanished in a flash. And deep within that rune, as if an invisible eye was peering through the cracks of fate, quietly watching him...
